reconstruction_summary: Re-ran the agent's favourite V2 model: per-segment straight-regime bias removal then global gain K*=1.090329 (taken from out/summary.json) applied to the existing yaw_rate_pred_rads column.
notes: V2 model: pred = K_star * (pred0 - per-segment straight-regime bias). K_star=1.090329 was fitted by the agent on Mustang Mach-E only; here it is applied uniformly across all 545 Ford segments (incl. F-150 Lightning). Per-segment bias is recomputed on each canonical segment from its STRAIGHT (|yaw_rate_meas|<0.05) rows, matching the agent's V1 procedure.
